scripts.dev: npm run prepare-site && bundle exec jekyll serve --source site --destination site/_site --config site/_config.yml --livereload --baseurl ""
scripts.build: npm run prepare-site && bundle exec jekyll build --source site --destination site/_site --config site/_config.yml && npm run check-site
scripts.preview: bundle exec jekyll serve --source site --destination site/_site --config site/_config.yml --skip-initial-build
